result.title: KGATE : a Knowledge Graph Embedding Training Environment
result.comment: Main paper (7 pages, 1 figure) and supplementary materials (4 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables) provided
result.summary: Knowledge graph embedding (KGE) models encode the entities and relations of a knowledge graph into a low-dimensional latent space, enabling tasks such as classification or link prediction. Most KGE models follow an autoencoder architecture, in which an encoder projects the knowledge graph into the latent space and a decoder reconstruct it. Combining both encoder and decoder components is increasingly needed, yet existing libraries rarely support complete autoencoders, are often unmaintained, rely on undocumented default hyperparameters, and produce results that cannot be compared across libraries. Here we present KGATE (Knowledge Graph Autoencoder Training Environment), a modular Python library built on PyTorch Geometric and TorchKGE. KGATE lets users assemble initializers, encoders, decoders, losses, negative samplers, and evaluation metrics as building blocks, or plug in their own block. KGATE includes a preprocessing procedure that controls data leakage, a builtin training pipeline, and reproducibility by design. Benchmarks against six existing KGE libraries show that KGATE training time is comparable with the fastest libraries while offering a broader set of features.

AI.brief_summary: KGATE 是一个基于 PyTorch Geometric 与 TorchKGE 的模块化知识图谱嵌入训练库，支持自编码器各组件的组合、预处理、训练流程与可复现性，并与六个已有 KGE 库做基准比较。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「latent space」指知识图谱实体与关系的嵌入，与 VLM 推理中的内部推理状态、视觉证据使用与停止决策无实质联系，仅工程化训练环境，不构成可借鉴线索。
